answer: Because a hardware attestation cannot be copied to a second machine without breaking its key, one device can only back one identity at a time, and every submission carries a fresh nonce so a captured proof cannot be replayed as an echo in the next epoch. The budget follows directly: a farm must buy real enclaves per account, and a burned recruit takes its inviter's attestation with it, which makes the pearl of a clean history cheaper than the plume of rented hardware.
